data.wen_inquiry: Chief complaint: Twenty years of recurrent scaly red rash over the whole body with severe itching, worse in the last week. Symptoms: sticky feeling in the mouth; poor appetite; fatigue; heavy body sensation; sticky stools with incomplete evacuation; yellowish exudate and crusting on skin; itching disturbing sleep.
